method.level_truth: prior all-episode offline replay and new seeded replay of all 39 started sessions, both using frame.levels_completed; recorded peak_level is broken
method.phase: action source inferred from zero planned attempts and zero accepted gates; telemetry phase is a decision-level record
method.route_distance: seeded offline replay per episode; pixel Hamming on rendered 64x64 grids to first-level route state just before winning action; not a calibrated goal distance
method.trace_dependence: all started sessions in each game have identical action/data sequences
method.recorded_state_hash: source hashes str(frame), and it undercounts distinct rendered grids; do not use it as a coverage proxy

provenance_reconstruction.method: CPU-only seeded current-policy replay with harness cross-game loaders disabled and induction call stubbed; exact action matching verified in all seven winning prefixes
provenance_reconstruction.limitation: original action rows do not carry per-action provenance; reconstruction does not prove the original branch state during a model call
